doc: Named biome presets — a `grass` verb with {preset: <name>} composes these strokes. Template vocabulary (interpreted by presetStrokes, flora_args.js): `species` literal; `density` is multiplied by the caller's density factor (the sparse/lush dial must reach composed biomes); `inset` shrinks width/depth by metres; `offset` is a [fx, fz] pair of min(W,D) FRACTIONS added to the caller's center (de-centred organic stands); `seedAdd` offsets the caller's seed (each stroke its own stream); anything else (variant, footprint, …) passes through verbatim. A logged bag naming a preset this instance lacks fails LOUDLY — logged meaning must never silently drift.

mojave.doc: Big-galleta carpet + three shrub species in de-centred organic stands + yucca.
